summary: Session 4 P10 after the 4th P5 reopen (b13 quiz.answer props made 0-based). Lead looked at all 15 contact sheets before three critic passes; check passes (18 warnings). Final critic pass on the current build: 1 major (b05, accepted with measurement), 3 minors accepted.

The 'Two weeks later' tab is the kit's flip state inside the header strip, left unchanged.

findings.problem: Critic: explanation card arrives at about 110.2 s, about 2 s before the cut, under the reading floor for 13 words (raised again as minor in pass 3).
findings.reason: The template reveals it on the say_explanation anchor 'B gives him an action', spoken at that moment; the card restates the three marks the viewer built over b07 to b11 and sees again in b15. Moving the anchor needs a P5 change and all 4 reopens are used. Lesson learned for next time: put say_explanation on an earlier phrase.

findings.reason: Leo's close (leo_close station) keeps Leo screen right on the 180 line with the wall as breathing room; the tag and its note are the subject. A layout change would break the b04 to b06 station continuity.

findings.reason: Moved there in session 4 to clear Leo's face and the answer bubble; it reads as a note on the wall beside the planner, and b14 now mirrors it on the same wall side.

findings.problem: Critic: the Actions needle, pointing straight up, crosses the word 'Actions'.
findings.reason: On the sheet the label sits above the dial and the needle stays inside the dial rim; at most a hairline touch on a label that is also spoken. The still needle is the point of the beat; not worth a scene change at this stage.

findings.problem: Critic: presenter card sized for a list holds one quote line, leaving its lower part empty.
findings.reason: Presenter avatar layout from the engine; the same card frame returns in b15 holding the three lines, so the empty card in b01 sets up the callback.

findings.problem: Deviations from the plan's measures (lesson-wide, logged on b11 where the push was dropped).
findings.reason: No push in b11 (dropped in session 3, an accent bar walks under the cards instead); avatar 13.6 % against the 0.1 mix ceiling (presenter bookends b01 and b15 by design); narration 132 s against 120 s requested (1.10x, within 1.3x); templates 2 of 15 (b12, b13); storyboard reference and callback suggestions not addressed.

findings.problem: Earlier minors: laptop slightly overlaps both chins in b02/b03/b14; static 'Next week' tab in every desk beat; Leo smiles with closed eyes on 'feels bad' in b02.
findings.reason: Small and legible on the sheets; the laptop is the kit part shared with b14's callback and moving it would break the mirror framing; the tab is kit furniture; the closed-eye face is the agreed 'head sink' read from session 2 (the peep kit has no sad face).
